name: Mobius Chord
source:
A "Illustrated novel game" collaboration project between Cybird and Kansai TV.

It is a youth love story that revolves around a group of friends who were connected in a band during their college days, and their ability to travel back into time to change the future as well reconcile their strained relationships.
